rv.q: Yet, for all its glaring faults, this engaging piece still marks her out as a playwright to watch.
In the course of 70 minutes, it offers a powerfully intense situation but denies us many of the traditional satisfactions of drama.
This is a play that simmers all the way to the boil.
Watching it is a powerful experience, but not an enlightening one.

cn.t: Tucker green's intense 70-minute drama about justice and vengeance divides critics: some praise its sharp satire and powerful situation, while others find its lack of context and traditional structure frustratingly opaque.
